line: A 1918 airmail sheet printed with its plane upside down: bought for $24, cut up and scattered, and number 66 is still missing.
line_cn: 1918 年一整版印反了的航空邮票：24 美元买下、剪开散落，66 号至今下落不明。
uses: Magazine-style explainers on ideas and society

labels: All type is printed on its own slip of paper and placed like any other piece: no type floats on the frame, no outlines or drop shadows on letters, only the slip's shadow.

Faces with a period feel, all OFL: an old-style serif (e.g. IM FELL English roman, italic and small caps) for titles and labels; a typewriter (e.g. Courier Prime) for slips, receipts and data; a CJK serif (e.g. Noto Serif SC, subset) for Chinese.

Ransom letters for a hero word or number: one slip per character, rotating fonts, papers and inks, slapped in one per eighth note. Old-style serifs have old-style figures (1 like I, 0 like o): digits come from a lining face.
Typewriter slips type out letter by letter on a blank slip (monospace advance), with a key sound per letter.
motion: On twos (12 drawings a second) for every paper piece; the camera moves smoothly every frame.
Slide in from off-frame with a small overshoot and a 2–3 drawing side-to-side settle; drops accelerate and bounce once; a slap arrives in two drawings (a slightly larger copy high above, then down).
Moving pieces carry a hand jitter (≈ 0.7 px, 0.25° per drawing); resting pieces are still.
Hinges turn around a pin and overshoot; a sheet can turn 180° flat on the table.

native_moves.does: a found print enters as a cut-out with its white margin; it can be cut again on screen with scissors and scatter.

native_moves.name: Assemble
native_moves.does: torn colour papers and cut-outs slide in one by one and build the scene or the subject.

native_moves.name: Turn the sheet
native_moves.does: a whole sheet or piece turns 180° flat on the table, or flips to show its back.

native_moves.name: Through the hole
native_moves.does: the camera enters a shape cut in the paper into the next scene.

native_moves.name: Ransom and typewriter
native_moves.does: words arrive letter by letter as slapped clippings or typed slips.

native_moves.name: Data engraving
native_moves.does: a value grows as engraved lines, the camera rises with it, a torn break marks a broken scale.
